title: Town founded
description: Augustinian missionaries found Bulakan as one of the early towns of the province. It grows along navigable rivers with Manila Bay trade.

title: Provincial hub
description: Bulakan serves as a center with an Augustinian convent and an alcalde mayor with jurisdiction over nearby settlements that later become separate towns.

title: Battle of Bulakan
description: On 18 January 1763, Spanish forces under Simón de Anda and local fighters face a British expedition during the British occupation of Manila.

title: Propaganda roots
description: Bulakan is home to Marcelo H. del Pilar (Plaridel) and Gregorio del Pilar — leaders tied to the Propaganda Movement and the Philippine Revolution.

title: Capital moves to Malolos
description: Under American rule, the provincial capital shifts to Malolos. Bulakan remains a coastal municipality with farming, fishing, and handicrafts.

title: Municipality of Bulakan
description: A municipality of 14 barangays in Bulacan, Region III. Population about 83,100 (2024 census). Official transactions run through the municipal eLGU portal.
